create_logsemiring: create a LogSemiring instance for log-space sum using logsumexp and addition
create_maxsemiring: create a MaxSemiring with optional smoothing and temperature for max-based operations
create_kbestsemiring: create a KBestSemiring with k top-k values and approximate or exact selection
create_samplingsemiring: create a SamplingSemiring with Gumbel-Softmax or ST-Gumbel-Softmax relaxation
run_semiring_einsum: run semiring-aware einsum operations with custom sum and mul functions on JAX arrays
